title: EMP from nuclear blast travels through dimensions

tellings.quote: The one thing we found out is that the EMP wave from a nuclear blast kind of travels through multiple dimensions.

plain: The electromagnetic pulse from a nuclear explosion, the burst of energy that can knock out electronics, travels through more than one dimension. The musician Tom DeLonge says this is "the one thing we found out," passing on what he was told by people he does not name. If true, it would help explain why unexplained objects take an interest in nuclear weapons.
